title: better-auth 1.3.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability…
description: better-auth versions 1.3.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 have an authorization vulnerability in the admin plugin's /admin/update-user endpoint. This flaw allows users with the user:update role to modify another user's phoneNumber and phoneNumberVerified fields. Exploiting this, an attacker can assign their own verified phone number to a higher-privileged account and gain access via phone OTP authentication.
